subject: Generate git format-patch series for ZFS update
description:
Create polished patch series for OSv mailing list submission - ZFS component.

After all ZFS implementation and testing is complete (tasks 1-6), generate a clean git commit history suitable for upstream submission:

1. Create logical commit sequence:
   - Commit 1: Add OpenZFS 2.3.6 submodule
   - Commit 2: Create module/os/osv/ platform directory structure
   - Commit 3: Implement OSv platform files (vdev_disk_osv.c, arc_os.c, etc.)
   - Commit 4: Update OSv build system for OpenZFS
   - Commit 5: Add ZFS update automation script
   - Commit 6: Add tests and documentation

2. Each commit must:
   - Have clear, descriptive commit message
   - Follow OSv commit message format
   - Build successfully
   - Pass existing tests

3. Generate patch series:
   ```bash
   git format-patch -o patches/zfs-update/ origin/master
   ```

4. Create cover letter (0000-cover-letter.patch):
   - Summary of changes
   - Testing performed
   - Performance comparison (old vs new ZFS)
   - Migration notes for users

Prerequisites: Tasks 1-6 complete

Deliverable: patches/zfs-update/ directory with formatted patches ready for email
